backend.name: Docker Engine native Linux / classic image store

command: node scripts/verify-isolation-live.mjs; mandatory live node scripts/verify-package.mjs; npm run check

caseEvidence.success: Real source and installed ISO-LIVE-01..09: immediate stdout/stderr, fixed nonroot identity/environment, denied host/symlink/shell escape, isolated network and observed/enforced cgroup/tmpfs/memory/PID/CPU limits.
caseEvidence.permission_denied: Real source and installed ISO-LIVE-11: chmod000 on owned Unix socket prevents a connection; profile/host-write denials also exercised. No synthetic Docker success is used as containment evidence.
caseEvidence.cancelled: Real source and installed ISO-LIVE-10/12: owned stop and actual official SDK request cancellation reach zero active/shared jobs and independent Docker owner-label absence.
caseEvidence.deadline: Real source and installed ISO-LIVE-10: observes the fresh job running before timeout, then confirms owned removal. Host-supervised cooperative deadline, not post-crash hard wall-clock guarantee.
caseEvidence.unsupported_platform: Synthetic unsupported Engine/version/capability inputs fail closed in fixture-1 on this real Linux host. This negative protocol observation grants no additional host/backend support.

limitations: Native Linux x64 with the observed classic-image-store backend only is live-qualified. Windows/macOS/ARM/WSL/Desktop are unsupported; denial does not establish containment.

The first same-head Windows native attempt failed one existing private registration rename; subsequent focused and full reruns passed without code/settings changes. Cause unproven; original failure preserved.
Cooperative host-supervised deadlines; broker/daemon loss may leave a container bounded by kernel controls. Restart recovery and independent hard wall-clock supervision remain open.
No general native executable/pack isolation, GPU limit, remote execution or actual ChatGPT connector invocation is qualified.
Signed packages and eight pinned LICENSE/NOTICE files do not establish full runtime/image/transitive redistribution clearance. Runtime binaries/images are not included in MTerm npm package.
Final metadata-head checks/review, expected-head merge and post-merge main checks are subsequent observations.
